sources.snippet: DiT4DiT is a Vision-Action-Model (VAM) framework that combines video generation transformers with flow-matching-based action prediction for generalizable robotic manipulation. It supports both the tabletop and whole-body control for manipulation tasks. Notably, DiT4DiT stands as the first efficient VAM to achieve real-time whole-body control of humanoid robots.

sources.snippet: This section details DiT4DiT, an integrated Video-Action Model (VAM) designed for the joint optimization of Video and Action DiTs. By employing a dual flow-matching objective, our framework concurrently refines video synthesis and action prediction.
